By: [Clayton M. Christensen](https://www.christenseninstitute.org/clayton-m-christensen/)

Even the most outstanding companies can do everything right—yet still lose market leadership.

The Innovator’s Dilemma explains how companies miss out on new waves of innovation. No matter the industry, a successful company with established products _will_ get pushed aside unless managers know how and when to abandon traditional business practices.

Offering both successes and failures from leading companies as a guide, _The Innovator’s Dilemma_ offers readers a set of rules for capitalizing on the phenomenon of [Disruptive Innovation](https://www.christenseninstitute.org/theory/disruptive-innovation/) .
